messages:
ida: Initiating RC originate for 2026.03.22-rc1. Artifact: gcr.io/redwood/inference:2026.03.22-rc1. Need quick thumbs on DB flag, quiet window, and abort rules. Quiet window requested 01:30-03:30 UTC.

maria: I reviewed the changelog. Main change is scheduler refactor + tracing tags. DB flag is `rc_db_v3_migrate` and default=false. No automatic flips during promo.

devin: LGTM on scheduler refactor. Any special infra steps?

kevin: DB note: if anyone wants to run the migration later, we require a manual `dbctl migrate --id rc_v3` outside promotion window. Confirming default=false.

maria: rollback policy suggestion: auto-rollback to inference:2026.03.21-prod if either p95 >+12% OR 5xx rate >0.4% sustained for 4m, OR tail latency (#99) jumps >25%. Also enable deadman: if deploybot doesn't finish canary in 60m, pause and alert.

sre-rotation: Acknowledged. We'll watch p95, p99, 5xx%, CPU throttling, and request queue depth. Set alert thresholds based on the rollback numbers.

deploy-bot: incoming deploy request accepted. artifact=gcr.io/redwood/inference:2026.03.22-rc1, env=prod, plan=kv-warm->smoke->canary(3%->20%->100%), window=2026-03-23T01:30Z..2026-03-23T03:30Z. Will pin artifact after signoff.

build-bot: CI: all tests green on main (coverage 88%). Image scanned: no CVEs above medium.

olivia: Release notes draft: https://redwood.internal/relnotes/2026-03-22-rc1 includes migration steps, `rc_db_v3_migrate` guidance, rollback snippets, and known issues.

devin: smoke run locally: ok. +1 from me once deploy-bot pins.

ida: pin requested. Please include deploy annotation with changelog link.

deploy-bot: pin applied: gcr.io/redwood/inference:2026.03.22-rc1 -> refs/rc-pins/2026-03-22 by ida. Annotation: https://redwood.internal/relnotes/2026-03-22-rc1

maria: starting kv-warm and schema-check at ~01:35 UTC. Oncall @sre-rotation stand by for rollback.

sre-rotation: standing by. will run manual revert if thresholds crossed.

ida: canary start: 3% at 01:38. monitoring dashboards now.

deploy-bot: traffic moved: 3% -> gcr.io/redwood/inference:2026.03.22-rc1. Initial smoke ok.

kevin: quick sanity: DB connections stable, no schema mismatch.

sre-rotation: first 10m metrics: p95 +4%, p99 +8% (within thresholds), 5xx 0.06%. continuing monitor.

maria: ramp to 20% at ~01:55 if no regressions. please thumbs.

devin: +1 for ramp.

ida: ramping to 20% now.

deploy-bot: traffic moved: 20% -> gcr.io/redwood/inference:2026.03.22-rc1. Running extended smoke.

sre-rotation: at 20% (15m): p95 +6%, p99 +10%, 5xx 0.09%. memory/heap stable. No alert conditions met.

maria: final signoffs: devin +1, kevin +1, olivia +1, ida +1. Promote to 100% at ~02:10 if stable.

ida: preparing rollback snippet for quick exec: `deployctl promote --to gcr.io/redwood/inference:2026.03.21-prod --reason "auto-rollback metrics" --preserve-routes`. Keep this handy in pager.

olivia: updated relnotes with rollback example and post-promote checklist (telemetry assertions).

maria: promoting to 100% now.

deploy-bot: Promotion initiated -> stepping to 100% over 10m. Deadman timer set (60m).

sre-rotation: Observability check 10m after full promo: p95 +3%, p99 +6%, 5xx 0.07%. No degradation.

ida: publish release ticket update and close promo workstream. Thanks all.

sre-rotation: closing thread 00% stable. If any anomalies, reopen or file incident.
